sources.name: Barrie Public Library
sources.notes: Communico/libnet feed, same pattern as Brampton/Oakville libraries - confirmed live 2026-11-04 with real JSON (250 events in a 30-day window, 69 not aimed at kids, e.g. conversation circles). Library runs dedicated newcomer programming (barrielibrary.ca/bpl-for-me/newcomers) and has hosted the Barrie Latin Resource Centre's 'Navigating Immigration' sessions.

sources.name: MacLaren Art Centre
sources.notes: Confirmed live 2026-11-04 - WordPress + The Events Calendar (123 upcoming events). Downtown Barrie public gallery (Mulcaster St). Feed is mostly paid classes and the Rogers TV bingo fundraiser, so expect scoring to drop most rows; free exhibition openings and community days are the keepers.

sources.name: Emmanuel Barrie
sources.notes: Confirmed live 2026-11-04 - WordPress + The Events Calendar (225 upcoming events). Hosts Centred Young Adults (Thursdays 7-9pm, Emmanuel Barrie Chapel), which is already on the HIS Barrie page. Feed also carries men's/women's groups and Bible studies.

sources.name: Georgian College - Barrie Campus
sources.notes: The single best-fit source for this city (large international cohort; Conversation Circles, Thrifty Thursdays newcomer-finance talks, Free Clothing Market, GCSA Barrie events). Gatsby front end over headless WordPress + Events Manager; the events page loads /wp-json/georgian/v1/future-events (recurring series already expanded, local times). Parser keeps '- Barrie' and untagged college-wide events, drops other campuses and academic-calendar deadlines. Confirmed 2026-11-05: 124 rows, 46 Barrie/college-wide in a Nov-Feb window.

sources.name: Downtown Barrie BIA
sources.notes: WordPress site listing the Barrie Farmers' Market and downtown events, but /wp-json/tribe/events/v1/events returns rest_no_route - checked 2026-11-04. Farmers' Market (Saturdays 9am-1pm, City Hall) is already on the HIS Barrie page.

sources.name: Tourism Barrie - Festivals & Events
sources.notes: Sitefinity calendar (/festivals-events/details/YYYY/MM/DD/default-calendar/<slug>) carrying the big city festivals (Barrie Film Festival, Locallicious, Hello Winter, Downtown Countdown). No parser for Sitefinity yet.

sources.name: Simcoe County Immigration - Settlement Services
sources.notes: County newcomer portal, linked from the HIS Barrie page. Runs Week of Welcome each September (job fairs, citizenship ceremony). No tribe route (rest_no_route) - checked 2026-11-04.
